business_problem: Milliman is a data company at their core, and their MedInsight product group is focused on helping U.S. healthcare customers — payers, providers, nonprofits, municipalities, etc.
solution_summary: Milliman Medinsight built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Databricks Data + AI Platform, MLflow, Auto Loader. Milliman is a data company at their core, and their MedInsight product group is focused on helping U.S. healthcare customers — payers, providers, nonprofits, municipalities, etc. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. MLflow tracks model experiments and repeatable machine learning workflows. Auto Loader incrementally ingests new files or events into the lakehouse as data arrives. One of the big reasons why Milliman turned to Databricks Data + AI Platform was because they looked to the future and planned with AI in mind.
